body: upload.Sessions issues ID.secret tokens (store keeps only SHA-256 of the secret), redeems them as an upload.Resolver (header Upload-Session) so every handler (Handler, Chunked, Uppy, PresignHandlerWith, LimitsHandler) honours them; expiry is judged by the Sessions clock, not the store; session limits may only narrow the endpoint policy and are re-checked against the current policy at every redemption; sessions are not use-counted (redeemable until expiry). Stores: upload.MemorySessions (core, stdlib) and records/uploadsessions (fs_upload_sessions). tus has no Resolve option, so sessions there only gate via Authorize.
title: UP-15 upload sessions live in upload as a Resolver over a pluggable SessionStore
